findings.title: connect() before NCEngine.initialize fails silently
findings.body: Calling connect without initialize returns code 31004 token errors that look like auth failures. Initialize first, always.

findings.title: connect before NCEngine initialize gives silent failure
findings.body: Same issue as scouts report — connect() before initialize() yields 31004. The error looks like a bad token but is actually init order.

findings.title: Token refresh silently logs ZZQX-42 in debug builds
findings.body: When the access token rotates, the engine logs marker ZZQX-42 at WARN level before reconnecting. Harmless but alarming in demos.

findings.title: Provider mounts empty without app.ready()
findings.body: nc-chat-ui-app-provider appended before NCChatUIApplication.ready() mounts a blank tree. Bootstrap order must be initialize -> ready -> mount -> connect.

findings.title: Custom message types never render in ChatUI lists
findings.body: Registered custom messages (isPersisted, isCounted) arrive via the SDK handler and history but ChatUI renders no bubble for them. Needs an app-built renderer.

findings.title: file: URLs need authToken omitted not empty
findings.body: @libsql/client throws a cryptic auth error for file:dev.db when authToken is an empty string. Pass undefined instead.

findings.title: cacheComponents rejects route segment dynamic exports
findings.body: export const dynamic = force-dynamic fails the build when cacheComponents is enabled. Remove the export; dynamic functions stay dynamic via request data.

findings.title: set-state-in-effect lint rule fires on sync setState
findings.body: The new react-hooks/set-state-in-effect rule rejects synchronous setState inside useEffect. Defer initial loads with setTimeout(0) or move them to event handlers.

findings.title: CLI env add prompts for NEXT_PUBLIC credential-looking vars
findings.body: vercel env add blocks non-interactively for NEXT_PUBLIC_* names that look like credentials. Pass --type config --value ... --yes to confirm public exposure.

findings.title: esbuild bundling inside a spec needs platform externals
findings.body: Bundling SDK code with node builtins fails with could not resolve path. Add --external:path --external:fs etc; the IS_NODE branches never execute in the browser.

findings.title: getSubChannels 35011 needs server-side subchannel list
findings.body: The client community cache is not synced right after connect (code 35011 ultra group not synced). Resolve rooms via /v4/community-channel/subchannel/list instead.

findings.title: subchannelId must be alphanumeric under 20 chars
findings.body: Server API rejects slugs with dashes (code 1002 subchannelId is not standardized). Normalize room slugs to a-z0-9 before create.
